verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions receipt scanning and API endpoints for receipts and card transactions. None of it documents automatic matching of receipts to card transactions, e-receipts pulled from integrations, or targeted nudges when a receipt is missing. Receipt scanning is an adjacent capture feature, not the matching capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing
